notes: Practical exercises and advanced exercises share continuous numbering 1–1431.
Review questions restart at 1 in each chapter; research tasks restart at 1 for each grade.
Some chapter final pages are shared with the following advanced section.
The full course must also inventory theoretical worked examples and appendix content; no exhaustive subpart/example count is claimed.
Raw OCR files are uncorrected and cannot be used as authoritative mathematics or source statements.
All printed-page ranges are inclusive; PDF page numbers are printed page + 1.
